description:
CloudScale Technologies is a European cloud infrastructure and distributed platform engineering company. We build resilient, high-availability SaaS backbones that process tens of millions of concurrent requests daily for tier-1 enterprise clients across financial technology, logistics, and digital services.

We are looking for a Backend Software Engineer with strong Python expertise to join our Core Platform & Services team.

You will collaborate closely with Software Engineers, Frontend Developers, Cloud/DevOps specialists, and Product Managers to architect scalable microservices, design robust RESTful and asynchronous communication layers, optimize high-throughput relational databases, and ensure mission-critical service reliability.
